item.title: The Rise of the Rosé States
item.description: It would be a mistake to think the electorate’s political disposition in former GOP bastions has turned blue.

item.title: AI Will Dehumanize the Job Hunt
item.description: And we’ll all be poorer for it.

item.title: The Nvidia Scandal Is a Warning Shot
item.description: The efforts that the Chinese appear to be making to get hold of a U.S. product make the case for not selling it to them.

item.title: Where Does the U.S.-Israel Relationship Go from Here?
item.description: Opposition to Israel now has a toehold in both parties.
